name: MediPal Holdings Corporation
summary: MediPal Holdings Corporation engages in the prescription pharmaceutical wholesale business in Japan. The company engages in the manufacture and supply of medical drugs, medical devices, medical supplies, clinical test reagents, and medical equipment and materials; non-life insurance agency business; outsourcing of medical office administration services; research and development of preventive medicine and cutting-edge medical technologies; and construction of a medical materials database.
